skill_selections.name: how
skill_selections.decision: Trace installer check behavior and current test helpers before moving tests.

skill_selections.name: tdd
skill_selections.decision: Add direct behavioral tests for each requested check failure and immutability.

skill_selections.name: pocock-tdd
skill_selections.decision: Exercise the public installer check entry point and its real mismatch verifier.

skill_selections.name: implement
skill_selections.decision: Keep the change confined to focused test modules.

skill_selections.name: code-review
skill_selections.decision: Inspect the focused diff for production coupling and tautological mocks.

testing_choice.reason: The installer exposes fast public check seams and filesystem behavior that can be verified directly.

principles.name: principle-laziness-protocol
principles.decision: Move existing classes intact before adding only the requested cases.

principles.name: principle-subtract-before-you-add
principles.decision: Remove the oversized classes from the broad module before extending coverage.

principles.name: principle-minimize-reader-load
principles.decision: Give Claude installer and hook-trust behavior one focused module each.

principles.name: principle-model-the-domain
principles.decision: Organize tests by installer failure category and observable result instead of installer implementation phase.

principles.name: principle-foundational-thinking
principles.decision: Use temporary repository trees as the shared test data shape for file-state checks.

principles.name: principle-redesign-from-first-principles
principles.decision: Treat focused installer ownership as the natural test layout rather than appending to the catch-all module.

principles.name: principle-prove-it-works
principles.decision: Run focused unittest modules, line-count checks, and git diff validation.

principles.name: principle-sequence-verifiable-units
principles.decision: Verify the class move before adding failure-path cases, then run the combined focused suite.
